fields.summary_ko.0: Following NVDA's leadership crisis, TSM and ASML each declined 9.5% and 10.8% over the month, but NVDA's Q3 EPS of $2.68 and revenue of $115.84B exceeded expectations.
fields.summary_ko.1: Nvidia provided Q4 revenue guidance of $130B (±3%), confirming continuity of relationships with suppliers, so TSM and ASML warrant buying consideration based on positive Zacks Rank.
